prompt:
Use case: text-localization.
Asset type: NSPA 2026 workshop success-criteria infographic for the existing public workshop website.
Edit target: the referenced portrait learning-intentions infographic. Preserve its polished paper-cut/frosted-glass illustrations, three numbered stacked panels, portrait 3:4 proportions, broad white space, and established palette: teal #007681, slate #2E4F66, orange #FF7233, gold #FFCD34, pale aqua #E4F4F4. Keep the magnifying-glass documents, respectful human conversation, and checklist illustrations. Keep the overall composition and professional type style. Create an updated sibling edition; the six criteria must match the current 31-slide presentation.
Replace the text with this EXACT copy, with six and only six gold checkmark bullets in the third panel. Make the third panel large enough for all six bullets, use the shortened copy below for legibility, keep its checklist illustration narrow at the right, and do not overlap text with art. No additional text, no invented claims, no 30/60/90-day plan, no schedule table.

Top title: "My success criteria"
Subtitle: "Trust, Transparency, and AI"

Panel 1 heading: "What am I learning today?"
Panel 1 paragraph: "I am learning how AI can support scholarship teams and applicants while people protect information, verify evidence, and make decisions."

Panel 2 heading: "Why am I learning this?"
Panel 2 paragraph: "Clear rules and evidence checks help me protect applicant trust, treat people fairly, and explain scholarship decisions."

Panel 3 heading: "How will I know I learned it?"
Panel 3 introduction: "I can:"
Six bullets, verbatim:
1. "Write a prompt with a task, approved inputs, the actual rubric, boundaries, and checkable output."
2. "Verify document flags, rubric evidence, and reviewer handoffs against their sources."
3. "Name who approves inputs, checks outputs, and makes the final decision."
4. "Check tool approval, data protection, and fairness before real use."
5. "Explain applicant AI rules and respond fairly when an essay is flagged."
6. "Plan one limited pilot with a human safeguard, an owner, and a review date."

Footer: "NSPA 2026 · Miguel Guhlin · mguhlin.org"

Use clear high-resolution typography, preserve correct spelling and exact wording, and balance the panel heights around the copy. The infographic must feel like the same NSPA resource, with meaningful illustrations rather than a plain text list.
